info.title: Invertio Inspection Management System API
info.description: Production-grade RESTful API for Invertio Inspection Management System (Musadaqah Business Solution). Provides complete end-to-end lifecycle coverage from Lead to Proposal, Digital Acceptance, Invoicing, Gate-Pass Engineer Validation, Inspections, and QR-verifiable Certification.

cookieAuth.name: invertio_session
cookieAuth.description: HTTP-only secure JWT session cookie set upon successful authentication.

bearerAuth.description: Standard Bearer JWT authentication header for cross-origin and network IP client support.

details.description: Structured details such as fieldErrors or blocking documents

post.description: Authenticates user credentials using bcrypt and issues an HTTP-only secure cookie.

200.description: Successfully authenticated with session cookie set and JWT bearer token returned

token.description: Signed compact JWT session token for Bearer authorization

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: (Optional) Search term for client name, email, or phone

post.description: Creates a lead with deduplication protection. Returns 409 if active lead with same email, phone, and source already exists.

assignedTo.description: (Optional) User ID of assigned sales rep

variables.description: (Compulsory) Template placeholder variables. Must supply all {{var}} tags.

post.summary: Send proposal and generate public acceptance link
Manually sign and accept proposal to generate binding tax invoice
post.description: Records manual/offline contract signature (wet ink, signed purchase order, physical acceptance) on a proposal, transitions status to 'accepted', converts linked lead, and issues a ZATCA-compliant Tax Invoice.

signatoryName.description: (Optional) Full name of client authorized signatory (e.g. 'Eng. Tariq Al-Mansoor')

signatoryEmail.description: (Optional) Signatory email address for invoice dispatch

poNumber.description: (Optional) Client Purchase Order (PO) number or physical contract reference

signingMethod.description: (Optional) Verification method for physical acceptance. Defaults to 'wet_signature'.

notes.description: (Optional) Additional internal audit notes regarding the manual signing

200.description: Proposal marked as accepted and Tax Invoice created successfully

get.summary: Public view proposal preview and PDF
get.description: Public unauthenticated endpoint for clients to view proposal terms and embedded PDF.

post.description: Accepts the proposal, automatically generates an Invoice (INV-XXXXXX) with 15% VAT, and transitions the lead to converted.

get.summary: Get invoice details and payment history

post.description: Processes payment status. On success, transitions invoice to 'paid' and creates a Work Order. Idempotent on repeated calls.

200.description: Payment processed or idempotent duplicate recognized

get.summary: Get work order details with inspection & certificate

patch.summary: Assign engineer with gate-pass credential validation
patch.description: Validates engineer's IQAMA, driving license, and car registration. Rejects assignment with 422 if any document is expired.

422.description: Gate-pass check failed due to expired documents

patch.summary: Admin emergency reopen of work order for re-inspection

get.summary: Get checklist template for work order

post.description: Submits answers and equipment details. If ANY answer is 'no', server enforces 'unsafe' outcome.

answers.description: (Compulsory) Map of checklist item keys to status (yes/no/na) and optional comment

409.description: Inspection already submitted for this work order

422.description: Contradictory submission ('no' answers marked as safe)

patch.summary: Assign engineer to inspection work order (Route Alias)
patch.description: Alias for /api/work-orders/{id}/assign. Validates engineer credentials and enforces gate-pass compliance.

422.description: Gate-pass denial due to expired credentials

404.description: Work order or engineer not found

post.summary: Issue official certificate with QR and PDF
post.description: Requires 'safe' inspection result. Issues CERT-YYYY-XXXXXX, signs QR JWT token, and builds PDF.

409.description: Duplicate certificate already issued today for this equipment

get.description: Cryptographically verifies signed JWT from QR code and reads live status from database. Anti-enumeration: invalid and unknown tokens return identical 404 response.

200.description: Live certificate status (Valid, Expired, Revoked) and equipment details

post.description: Multipart form upload with magic-byte validation and past-expiry check.

422.description: Empty file, past expiry, or disallowed executable/script

post.summary: Upload new version of existing document

409.description: Blocked: Engineer is assigned to active work orders

post.description: Admin endpoint scanning 30d, 7d, 1d, and expired documents/certificates. Deduplicated via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

get.summary: Download engineer performance report (CSV, Excel, PDF, JSON)
get.description: Aggregates completed, in progress, and total work order jobs per certified engineer. Supports tabular PDF rendering, Excel export, and streaming CSV.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or after this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or before this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: Report file stream (CSV, Excel, or PDF) or JSON telemetry payload

get.summary: Download client revenue and billing audit report (CSV, Excel, PDF, JSON)
get.description: Financial ledger reporting total billed, collected revenue (paid), and outstanding receivables per client organization with KSA VAT compliance.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or after this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or before this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: Report file stream (CSV, Excel, or PDF) or JSON billing payload

get.summary: Download branch / operational location workload report (CSV, Excel, PDF, JSON)
get.description: Geographic workload reporting detailing total work orders, completed jobs, open jobs, and unique clients served across operational branch and inspection site locations.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or after this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or before this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: Report file stream (CSV, Excel, or PDF) or JSON geographic workload payload

get.summary: Download equipment classification compliance report (CSV, Excel, PDF, JSON)
get.description: Equipment category analytics for lifting equipment, petroleum tankers, heavy trailers, and industrial forklifts with safe/unsafe pass rates and issued certificate counts.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or after this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: [Optional] Filter records created on or before this date (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: Report file stream (CSV, Excel, or PDF) or JSON category compliance payload

get.description: Calculates active, expired, and revoked certificate totals for statutory dashboard monitoring.

post.summary: Run automated statutory expiry scan routine
post.description: Scans all active gate-pass credentials and accredited certificates across 30d, 7d, 1d, and expired intervals. Dispatches alerts with idempotency deduplication. Restricted to admin role.

200.description: Summary of scanned, notified, and deduped records

message.example: Expiry scan complete: 12 scanned, 3 notified, 0 deduped.

get.description: Retrieves audit log stream of statutory alert notifications dispatched to operators and clients.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: [Optional] Maximum number of notification records to retrieve (default 50, max 100).

200.description: Array of notification dispatch logs with template keys and delivery status

get.description: Lists all users and engineers belonging to the tenant, including credential compliance indicators and active assignment counts.

200.description: Array of user profiles with compliance metrics

post.description: Creates a new user or field engineer with hashed credentials. Newly created engineers are immediately available for Work Order assignment.

password.description: Optional custom password; defaults to secure tenant standard if omitted

get.description: Returns all registered client entities with aggregated operational and commercial metrics.

200.description: Array of corporate clients with totals

get.description: Returns full portfolio for a client: profile, all work orders, all inspections with checklist results, all certificates, and commercial billing history.

post.description: Creates an official ZATCA-compliant Tax Invoice directly for either an existing Corporate Client or an active Unconverted Lead. Automatically computes 15% VAT and records audit trail.

clientName.description: (Compulsory) Name of corporate client or lead

subtotal.description: (Compulsory) Subtotal amount in SAR excluding VAT

description.example: Statutory Periodic Crane & Pressure Vessel Inspection

clientId.description: (Optional) Reference UUID of the registered corporate client

leadId.description: (Optional) Reference UUID of the active lead. If provided, the lead will be automatically marked as converted.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: (Optional) Filter by work order operational status

post.summary: Create new industrial work order directly for client
post.description: Generates a unique WO sequence, verifies gate-pass credentials if an engineer is assigned, and sets initial operational status.

clientName.description: (Compulsory) Name of client entity or facility

scope.example: Comprehensive statutory 10-year load test and magnetic particle crack detection.

assignedEngineerId.description: (Optional) User UUID of field engineer to assign (must have active gate pass credentials)

certificateValidityDays.description: (Optional) Validity period of issued compliance certificate in days
